decisions.notes: All 12 views inspected. Crossbow with a shaped wooden stock, a leather grip wrap, a steel prod, a modelled string and stirrup, a trigger lever and a bolt seated in the groove. Small brass star inlays decorate the stock; these are decorative motifs, not a brand or maker's mark. The prod, stirrup and string are real geometry from every angle and the bolt is visible in the top view. Free-standing weapon, unrigged.
limitations: The string is static, so the crossbow cannot be re-cocked or fired without rigging.
The bolt is fused into the groove and cannot be removed.

decisions.notes: All 12 views inspected. Halberd with a long banded haft, an axe blade, a rear spike, a top thrusting point and a pink cloth tassel bound below the head. The blade, spike and point are all present and correctly aligned in the end-on views, and the tassel is modelled geometry rather than a card. Materials score 4 for flat colour. Free-standing weapon, unrigged.
limitations: The tassel is static geometry and will not sway.

decisions.notes: All 12 views inspected. Flanged mace with six raised steel flanges around a tapered head, a brass collar, a steel shaft, a ribbed leather grip and a brass pommel with a real open suspension ring. The flange count and spacing are consistent around the axis in the end-on views, and the suspension ring is open tube geometry rather than a solid disc. Materials score 4 for flat metal colour. Free-standing weapon, unrigged.

All 12 views inspected. Woman with shoulder-length waved auburn hair, a terracotta open blazer with lapels and pocket flaps over a white top, navy wide-leg cropped trousers and plain white trainers. The blazer has a proper back yoke and vent, the hair is closed shell geometry from the top and back, and the wide trouser hems are open rings with visible leg geometry inside rather than capped cylinders. Deliberately stylised face and proportions, so style fit is 4. Rigged: 54-bone humanoid armature (24 body + 30 finger bones), walk and run clips, zero unweighted skinned vertices.
limitations: AI-assisted origin is disclosed upstream (origin.ai_content); some storefronts require an AI-content disclosure when you resell.
Stylised proportions; not a photoreal human.
Hair is modelled shells, not groomed strands.

decisions.notes: All 12 views inspected. Farmer with a woven straw hat, a red plaid shirt with rolled cuffs, a yellow neckerchief, faded denim bib overalls with brass buckles and stitch detail, and green rubber boots. The denim shows believable wear and fade grading, the plaid aligns across the shirt seams, and the rear views confirm the overall bib straps cross correctly at the back with rear pockets present. The straw hat has a modelled woven brim visible in the top view. Rigged: 54-bone humanoid armature (24 body + 30 finger bones), walk and run clips, zero unweighted skinned vertices.
limitations: AI-assisted origin is disclosed upstream (origin.ai_content); some storefronts require an AI-content disclosure when you resell.
The hat is fused to the head.

decisions.notes: All 12 views inspected. Female sci-fi soldier in white powered armour with teal accent channels, graphite under-suit panels at the joints, segmented pauldrons, articulated knee and elbow guards, armoured boots and a full helmet with a teal visor. The panel lines and accent channels line up across the front, sides and back, the spine of the suit carries a matching detail strip, and the visor is opaque so no face is required underneath. Clean closed geometry in the top and bottom views. Rigged: 54-bone humanoid armature (24 body + 30 finger bones), walk and run clips, zero unweighted skinned vertices.
limitations: AI-assisted origin is disclosed upstream (origin.ai_content); some storefronts require an AI-content disclosure when you resell.
The helmet cannot be removed and there is no head geometry beneath the visor.
